item.title: Hegseth announces Pentagon probe into deadly strike on Iranian school
item.summary: Pentagon investigates deadly Iran strike that Tehran regime claims killed 168+ children at school by IRGC military site. U.S. investigation is underway.

item.title: ODU gunman who killed ROTC instructor had prior ISIS conviction, was released early
item.summary: Accused ODU shooter was previously convicted for ISIS support but released early in 2024 after serving reduced sentence, court documents show.

item.title: Iran moves hundreds of millions in crypto during nationwide internet blackout, report reveals
item.summary: A new report claims Iran's IRGC moved hundreds of millions in cryptocurrency during an internet blackout, suggesting sophisticated sanctions evasion operations.

item.title: Trump-backed voter ID bill faces GOP resistance as Tillis vows to stop it
item.summary: Senate Republicans are ready for a floor battle over a voter ID bill despite internal divisions, with Sens. Thom Tillis , R-N.C., and Lisa Murkowski, R-Alaska, in opposition.

item.title: Iran deploys explosive ‘suicide skiffs’ disguised as fishing boats in Strait of Hormuz
item.summary: Iranian suicide skiffs threaten global shipping as Supreme Leader vows to keep Strait of Hormuz closed, prompting U.S. Navy escort discussions and surging oil price

item.title: Hegseth cranks up pressure on US war colleges
item.summary: Secretary of War Pete Hegseth declared that a task force will scrutinize senior service colleges to ensure they provide quality education without wokeness.

item.title: Top butchers reveal the 3 fast-food cheeseburgers that actually use real, quality beef
item.summary: Award-winning butchers reveal their surprising top picks for the best fast-food cheeseburgers in America — and the winners might shock fans of popular giants.

item.title: James Carville tells Stephen A Smith Democrats 'do not know how to talk to young men'
item.summary: James Carville asked Stephen A. Smith how Democrats can reconnect with young men during a podcast discussion about political messaging and economic priorities.

item.title: Fingerprint and photo scans to be fully enforced for American travelers headed to one continent
item.summary: Starting April 10, American travelers to Europe must provide fingerprint scans and photos at borders. France, Italy, UK and 26 other countries are implementing the system.

item.title: Remote robot surgery removes cancer 1,500 miles away
item.summary: U.K. surgeons remotely removed a man’s prostate cancer from 1,500 miles away in the country’s first successful robot-assisted telesurgery.
